_about: The single place a project edits. Every tool reads this file (--config). Keys marked REPLACE are the eight items in standards section 14. Defaults below are the cybersci-prep pilot values.
name: example-project

domain._REPLACE: 1. Domain and categories: your backlog of topics with levels, hours and which goals need each

rules._REPLACE: 2. Rule catalog: stable ids for learning (A), visual (V) and practice-aid (P) rules

sources._REPLACE: 3. Source pack builder and retriever: how sources are captured and offered to the drafter

labs._REPLACE: 4. Sample data, sandbox, allow-list: what labs run on and which programs they may use

topic_fit._REPLACE: 5. Topic keyword lists: terms each topic must contain (set per topic in its spec: keywords, must_not_contain)

thresholds._REPLACE: 6. Thresholds: minimums by level, tuned on the first three topics

forbidden_facts._REPLACE: 7. Forbidden facts: facts the domain must never state in learner text unless a claims-register row records them

models._REPLACE: 8. Models: the models your hardware runs; every call is recorded in provenance
